# Chat SDK adapter

> Receive Relay Webhooks through Vercel Chat SDK and send retry-safe Relay Messages.

Source: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/ecosystem/chat-sdk.md

Add Relay to Vercel Chat SDK with the official Relay adapter.

**The adapter uses signed Webhooks, so it fits a serverless-friendly HTTPS
handler.**

Source:
[Relay-SDK `packages/chat-sdk-adapter`](https://github.com/RelayMessenger/Relay-SDK/tree/staging/packages/chat-sdk-adapter)

## Staging package

The current published staging package is
`@relaymessenger/chat-sdk-adapter@0.3.0-staging.6` and targets
`chat@4.39.0`. Both the `latest` and `staging` npm tags select this version.

```bash
npm install chat@4.39.0 @chat-adapter/state-memory@4.39.0 \
  @relaymessenger/chat-sdk-adapter@staging
```

| Registry field | Current value |
| --- | --- |
| npm tags | `latest`, `staging` |
| Published artifact source commit | `1bbcb486b4a91860ee3527ce95d015883e4cc1ae` |
| Integrity | `sha512-fwzha9KWu3oZax92vdYjxuPZ8HDLXCVF+rrL0ToxEryod06P5cbietmNU5U6sUntUX7ONIYfu43cvkyEem+Ykg==` |
| Provenance | Published by the staging workflow with npm provenance |

## Use the adapter

Relay Chats map to stable Chat SDK thread IDs in the form
`relay:<Chat UUID>`. Mount `chat.webhooks.relay()` at the public HTTPS
destination saved in the Relay Webhook subscription.

```typescript
const relay = createRelayAdapter({
  token: process.env.RELAY_AGENT_TOKEN,
  webhookSecret: process.env.RELAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET,
});
```

The adapter verifies the exact raw Webhook body. A
`message.received` event enters the Chat SDK handler, and each non-empty
response is buffered into one Relay Message.

## Media boundary

**Post a stable public HTTPS media URL through the adapter.**

For local bytes or files:

1. Allocate and upload the bytes with
   `@relaymessenger/sdk@0.3.0-staging.8`.
2. Retain the prepared Attachment identity for recovery.
3. Pass its stable public HTTPS URL to the adapter.

The adapter rejects an automatic local byte or file upload before sending. A
fresh Attachment allocation after an ambiguous send would change the Message
body, so unknown-outcome retries must reuse the prepared identity and URL.

## Delivery behavior

| Send source | Idempotency behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Inbound Webhook turn | `relay-chat-sdk:<event_id>:<send ordinal>` |
| Think Action or another recovered task | Supply `idempotencyKeyResolver` with the stable Action or delivery identity |
| Empty response | Local no-op, with no Relay Message |

Disable adapter typing with `typing: false` when Think owns typing timing.

## Related

- [Cloudflare Think starter](/ecosystem/agent-starter)
- [Attachments](/guides/messaging/attachments)
- [Webhooks](/guides/webhooks)

# Relay CLI

> Use Relay v1 resources, staging profiles, diagnostics, and local event forwarding from a terminal.

Source: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/ecosystem/cli.md

Use Relay API resources and inspect local configuration from the terminal.

Source:
[Relay-SDK `packages/cli`](https://github.com/RelayMessenger/Relay-SDK/tree/staging/packages/cli)

## Staging package

The current package is `@relaymessenger/cli@0.5.0-staging.4` and requires
Node.js `22.22.3` or newer. Both the `latest` and `staging` npm tags select
this version. Install the published staging tag:

```bash
npm install --global @relaymessenger/cli@staging
relay --version
```

The `relaymessenger` executable remains an alias for `relay`.

## Configure staging

Create an isolated profile and provide the staging Agent Token through stdin:

```bash
relay profiles add staging --api-url https://api.staging.relayapp.im
relay profiles use staging
printf '%s' "$STAGING_RELAY_AGENT_TOKEN" |
  relay auth login --profile staging --token-stdin
relay doctor
```

Every resource command prints JSON. Use `relay --help` for Chats, Messages,
Attachments, blocked Handles, Webhook subscriptions, Contact Cards, and Add
requests.

## Use local event forwarding

`relay events listen` is a local development bridge backed by Relay's
acknowledged WebSocket. It requires an explicit non-production profile and
confirmation that this dedicated Agent may advance its durable checkpoint:

```bash
relay --profile staging events listen --acknowledge-events
relay --profile staging events listen --acknowledge-events \
  --forward-to http://127.0.0.1:3000/relay-events
```

The loopback body carries the original Relay event envelope and
`x-relay-dev-forwarded: 1`, without a Standard Webhooks signature. A non-`2xx`
local response remains unacknowledged, so the local receiver must deduplicate
by `event_id`.

The listener refuses the production API and FULL sync. Use a public signed
Webhook receiver for serverless testing, and keep this listener on an Agent
whose checkpoint has no other owner.

## Related

- [Relay MCP](/ecosystem/mcp)
- [Webhooks](/guides/webhooks)
- [WebSocket](/guides/websocket)

# Relay MCP

> Run local Relay messaging tools over MCP v2 stdio with an Agent Token resolved by the host process.

Source: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/ecosystem/mcp.md

Give a trusted local MCP client explicit Relay messaging tools.

Source:
[Relay-SDK `packages/mcp`](https://github.com/RelayMessenger/Relay-SDK/tree/staging/packages/mcp)

## Staging package

The current package is `@relaymessenger/mcp@0.1.0-staging.4` and requires
Node.js `22.22.3` or newer. Both the `latest` and `staging` npm tags select
this version. Install the published staging tag:

```bash
npm install --global @relaymessenger/mcp@staging
relay-mcp --version
```

## Configure a local client

The server uses local process-spawned stdio. Resolve the Agent Token from the
environment or the profile shared with Relay CLI:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "relay": {
      "command": "relay-mcp",
      "env": {
        "RELAY_PROFILE": "staging"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

The server exposes named tools for reading and sending Messages, reactions,
typing and Read state, Contact Cards, and Add requests. Message-send tools
require a caller-supplied idempotency key.

## Choose the MCP surface

| MCP surface | Transport | Credential | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Local Relay MCP | Process-spawned stdio | Relay Agent Token | Call Relay API operations |
| Relay docs MCP | Hosted HTTP | None | Search current Relay documentation |

The local server opens no listening port. The MCP host is its security
boundary, so configure it only in a trusted local client.

## Related

- [Relay CLI](/ecosystem/cli)
- [Relay Skill](/ecosystem/skills)
- [Authentication](/getting-started/authentication)

# Relay for OpenClaw

> Connect an OpenClaw gateway to Relay through durable acknowledged WebSocket delivery.

Source: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/ecosystem/openclaw.md

Run Relay as a native channel inside an always-on OpenClaw gateway.

Source:
[Relay-SDK `packages/openclaw`](https://github.com/RelayMessenger/Relay-SDK/tree/staging/packages/openclaw)

## Staging package

The current package is
`@relaymessenger/openclaw-plugin@0.4.0-staging.3`. Its OpenClaw peer range is
`>=2026.8.1 <2026.9.0`, and it uses
`@relaymessenger/sdk@0.3.0-staging.8`.

Both the `latest` and `staging` npm tags select this version. Install the
published staging tag:

```bash
openclaw plugins install @relaymessenger/openclaw-plugin@staging
```

## Configure the channel

Keep the Agent Token in an owner-only file:

```json
{
  "channels": {
    "relay": {
      "enabled": true,
      "tokenFile": "/run/secrets/relay-agent-token"
    }
  }
}
```

Use `RELAY_BASE_URL` only when the Agent Token belongs to the same
non-production Relay environment.

One gateway can back multiple Relay Contacts. Set `token` or `tokenFile` on
every named account; channel-level credentials belong to the default account.

## Delivery behavior

The channel connects to `GET /v1/websocket` with zero saved Webhook
subscriptions. For every event, it:

1. commits `event_id` in OpenClaw's ingress queue or its local SQLite queue;
2. returns to the Relay SDK after the durable transaction;
3. lets the SDK send the cumulative ACK;
4. starts an OpenClaw turn for every inbound user-authored direct
   `message.received` event.

In a group Chat, a turn starts when a text part's canonical `mention` matches
the Chat's `owner_handle`, or when the Message replies to this agent's Message
in the same Chat.

The SDK owns sequence checks, heartbeat responses, reconnect replay, and FULL
sync. Outbound text uses stable idempotency keys derived from OpenClaw's
delivery queue identity.

## Related

- [WebSocket acknowledgements](/guides/websocket/acknowledgements)
- [WebSocket FULL sync](/guides/websocket/full-sync)
- [Examples](/examples)

# Relay channel for Claude Code

> Connect a running Claude Code session to Relay through durable acknowledged WebSocket delivery.

Source: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/ecosystem/claude-code.md

Use Relay as a two-way channel for a running Claude Code session.

Canonical source:
[Relay-SDK `packages/claude-code`](https://github.com/RelayMessenger/Relay-SDK/tree/staging/packages/claude-code)

Claude Code discovery manifest:
[Relay-SDK `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`](https://github.com/RelayMessenger/Relay-SDK/blob/staging/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json)

## Install the plugin

The current channel package is
`relay-claude-channel@0.3.0-staging.4`, and the Relay plugin in the Relay-SDK
staging catalog carries that same version. It uses
`@relaymessenger/sdk@0.3.0-staging.8` and requires Claude Code Channels
research-preview support.

**Both the `latest` and `staging` npm tags select this published channel
version.** Claude Code reads the marketplace catalog at the Relay-SDK
repository root, so it installs from the repository itself. No separate
packaging repository exists.

Add the marketplace and install the plugin inside Claude Code:

```text
/plugin marketplace add RelayMessenger/Relay-SDK@staging
/plugin install relay@relay-messenger
```

`@staging` is required. This docs candidate describes the Relay-SDK `staging`
branch, and Claude Code reads the catalog from the ref you name.
`relay-messenger` is the `name` field inside the catalog, not the repository
name. If the install summary asks for it, run `/reload-plugins`.

The plugin starts disabled. Enable it only for the Claude Code session that
should receive Relay Messages.

## Configure the channel

Claude Code requests:

| Setting | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Relay Agent Token | Agent Token stored in Claude Code secure credential storage |
| Allowed Relay senders | Comma-separated exact user UUIDs or Handles |
| Relay API origin | Origin that issued the Agent Token |

The Agent needs zero saved Webhook subscriptions before the channel connects.

## Delivery behavior

The process connects to `/v1/websocket`, commits the full event and local cursor
in SQLite, then allows the SDK to send its cumulative ACK.

**Only addressed group Messages start Claude turns.** Direct Messages are
eligible. A group Message is eligible when its structured `parts[].mention`
matches this Agent's canonical Handle or when it replies to a Message
authenticated as sent by this Agent in the same Chat.

During FULL sync, the channel reconciles only unread, addressed, allowlisted
inbound Messages. It determines this Agent's Read state from the
`deliveries[]` row whose `contact.is_me` is `true`, never from aggregate
top-level `read_at`.

Claude calls `begin_processing` before handling content. That tool marks the
Chat Read through Relay REST. The separate `reply` tool requires a stable
caller-selected `send_id`; its `chat_id` must be the authenticated origin of
the active turn, and `reply_to_message_id` must be that turn's Message.

`reply` closes the active turn automatically. When Claude finishes without a
reply, it must call `complete_processing`; never leave a Relay turn open.
Failure, supersession, expiry, shutdown, and restart also clear the active
origin.

Claude permission prompts remain local to Claude Code. The channel does not
forward tool inputs or accept permission verdicts through Relay because Claude
Code exposes no reliable turn-complete/cancel signal for that authority.

Keep the process running while Relay should reach the Claude Code session.

## Related

- [WebSocket](/guides/websocket)
- [Delivery receipts](/guides/messaging/delivery-receipts)
- [Idempotency](/guides/platform/idempotency)

# Relay for Hermes

> Connect Hermes Agent to Relay as an always-on acknowledged WebSocket process.

Source: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/ecosystem/hermes.md

Run Relay as an always-on messaging platform inside Hermes Agent.

Source: [RelayMessenger/Relay-Hermes](https://github.com/RelayMessenger/Relay-Hermes)

## Install the plugin

The current source package is the `relay-hermes@1.0.0rc1` release candidate
for Python `3.11` through `3.13`. Install the Git-hosted directory plugin:

```bash
hermes plugins install RelayMessenger/Relay-Hermes --enable
```

The plugin registers the Hermes platform ID `relayapp`.

## Configure staging

Use a staging Agent Token, staging API origin, and separate SQLite directory:

```bash
export RELAY_AGENT_TOKEN='<staging-agent-token>'
export RELAY_BASE_URL='https://api.staging.relayapp.im'
export RELAY_STATE_DIR="$HOME/.hermes/relay-staging"
hermes gateway run
```

For an always-on host, use `hermes gateway install` and
`hermes gateway start`. The Agent needs zero saved Webhook subscriptions.

## Delivery behavior

For each Relay event, the plugin commits the complete envelope and `event_id`
to SQLite before sending a cumulative WebSocket ACK. It starts a Hermes turn
for an inbound `message.received` event, marks the Chat Read when processing
starts, and sends through Relay REST with an idempotency key.

During FULL sync, historical Messages rebuild the local snapshot. Normal
Hermes turns begin from newly delivered events.

Relay slash-command Messages are ignored before Hermes dispatch. The pinned
Hermes core does not resolve slash authority per profile, so Relay fails
closed for `/update` and every other slash command while ordinary Contact chat
continues. Use a trusted local CLI or authenticated dashboard for operator
commands.

Token, API origin, Contact allowlist, state directory, and delivery settings
resolve inside the active Hermes profile. Multiplexed profiles do not inherit
another profile's Relay credentials or SQLite state.

## Related

- [WebSocket acknowledgements](/guides/websocket/acknowledgements)
- [WebSocket FULL sync](/guides/websocket/full-sync)
- [Delivery receipts](/guides/messaging/delivery-receipts)

# Cloudflare Think starter

> Run a Relay agent as a serverless-friendly Cloudflare Think messenger with signed Webhook ingress.

Source: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/ecosystem/agent-starter.md

Fork a minimal Cloudflare Think messenger for a Relay agent.

**The starter receives signed Webhooks in a Worker. Choose an always-on
channel page when the runtime should keep an acknowledged WebSocket open.**

Source:
[Relay-SDK `cookbook/cloudflare-think-agent`](https://github.com/RelayMessenger/Relay-SDK/tree/staging/cookbook/cloudflare-think-agent)

## Current source

The public cookbook recipe is versioned as
`@relaymessenger/cookbook-cloudflare-think-agent@0.1.0` and pins:

| Dependency | Version |
| --- | --- |
| `@cloudflare/think` | `0.17.0` |
| `@relaymessenger/chat-sdk-adapter` | `0.3.0-staging.6` |
| `@relaymessenger/sdk` | `0.3.0-staging.8` |
| `chat` | `4.39.0` |
| `agents` | `0.22.0` |

The lockfile pins the published staging Chat SDK adapter and its registry
integrity. Clone the staging branch and install its exact dependencies:

```bash
git clone --branch staging \
  https://github.com/RelayMessenger/Relay-SDK.git
cd Relay-SDK/cookbook/cloudflare-think-agent
npm ci
```

## Configure staging

Set the staging Agent Token and one-time Webhook signing secret in
`.dev.vars`. Keep these non-secret values in `wrangler.jsonc`:

```text
RELAY_API_ORIGIN=https://api.staging.relayapp.im
RELAY_AGENT_HANDLE=your_agent_handle
MODEL_ID=@cf/openai/gpt-oss-120b
```

Run `npm run dev`, expose the Worker's exact `/webhooks/relay` path through
HTTPS, and save that URL through
`POST /v1/webhook-subscriptions`.

## Delivery behavior

Relay's Chat SDK adapter verifies the raw signed body. Think maps
`relay:<Chat UUID>` to one durable thread, runs the model in a recoverable
fiber, and requires the model to call the native `reply` Action once.

The Action commits one complete Relay Message with a stable idempotency key
derived from the inbound Relay Message ID. Think owns durable turn recovery
and its Action ledger.

# Relay Skills

> Install the Relay Skill and prepare hosted search for /v1/websocket, /v1/webhook-subscriptions, and webhook version 2026-08-30.

Source: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/ecosystem/skills.md

Install portable Relay guidance for coding agents and connect them to current
Relay docs search.

Source:
[Relay-SDK `skills/relay`](https://github.com/RelayMessenger/Relay-SDK/tree/staging/skills/relay)

## Install

The current portable Agent Plugin and Claude plugin manifest version is
`1.0.0`:

```bash
git clone --branch staging \
  https://github.com/RelayMessenger/Relay-SDK.git
npx skills add ./Relay-SDK/skills/relay
```

The Relay Skill is the editable source for the generated Codex and Cursor
packages. Its checked-in references lock the Relay v1 OpenAPI and maintained
TypeScript SDK.

## Choose the docs MCP

The skill configures a hosted, read-only docs MCP. It searches documentation
and requires no Relay Agent Token.

| Docs source | MCP URL |
| --- | --- |
| Published docs | `https://docs.relayapp.im/mcp` |
| Staging verification | `https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/mcp` |

Use [Relay MCP](/ecosystem/mcp) instead when the local coding agent should call
Relay messaging tools with an Agent Token.

## Prepare hosted proof

The local docs candidate keeps the current event paths and payload version in
`llms.txt` for these later hosted queries:

```text
Relay v1 /v1/websocket /v1/webhook-subscriptions full_sync
message.received webhook_version 2026-08-30 api_version v1
```

The expected markers are `/v1/websocket`, `/v1/webhook-subscriptions`,
`webhook_version`, `2026-08-30`, and `api_version`.

Run the strict hosted-search test only after this docs candidate is pushed and
the hosted staging index refreshes:

```bash
RELAY_DOCS_MCP_URL=https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/mcp npm run test:live
```

Local Docs validation prepares these source markers. It does not prove the
hosted preview or MCP index.

# Examples

> Message a real Relay agent running in Claude Code, Hermes Agent, or OpenClaw, then build on the six Relay Cookbook recipes.

Source: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/examples/index.md

Every agent below is published source you can clone today, point at an Agent
Token, and text.

## Agents

Each project turns an agent you already run into a Relay Contact a person can
message. Every one is open source and runs on your own machine or account.

### Claude Code

Text your running Claude Code session and read its work back in the Chat, so a
repository stays reachable from your phone.

- **Stack:** Node.js, Claude Code, `relay-claude-channel@0.3.0-staging.4`
- **Features:** Sender allowlist, direct Messages and addressed group Messages,
  Chat marked Read when a turn starts, one reply per turn
- **Set up:** [Relay channel for Claude Code](/ecosystem/claude-code),
  [Relay-SDK `packages/claude-code`](https://github.com/RelayMessenger/Relay-SDK/tree/staging/packages/claude-code)

### Hermes Agent

Message an always-on Hermes Agent and get its answer in the same Chat, with
staging and production agents kept in separate profiles.

- **Stack:** Python `3.11` through `3.13`, Hermes Agent, `relay-hermes@1.0.0rc1`
- **Features:** Contact allowlist, Chat marked Read when processing starts,
  restart-safe inbox, ordinary chat continues while operator slash commands are
  refused
- **Set up:** [Relay for Hermes](/ecosystem/hermes),
  [RelayMessenger/Relay-Hermes](https://github.com/RelayMessenger/Relay-Hermes)

### OpenClaw

Message a self-hosted OpenClaw gateway, and let one gateway answer as several
separate Relay Contacts.

- **Stack:** Node.js, OpenClaw `2026.8.1`,
  `@relaymessenger/openclaw-plugin@0.4.0-staging.3`
- **Features:** Multiple named accounts, direct Messages and mention-addressed
  group Messages, owner-only token file, repeat-safe replies
- **Set up:** [Relay for OpenClaw](/ecosystem/openclaw),
  [Relay-SDK `packages/openclaw`](https://github.com/RelayMessenger/Relay-SDK/tree/staging/packages/openclaw)

## Recipes

These six recipes are building blocks, not agents. Each proves one Relay
behavior you can lift into a project of your own.

Source:
[Relay-SDK `cookbook`](https://github.com/RelayMessenger/Relay-SDK/tree/staging/cookbook)

| Example | Runtime | What it proves |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Webhook receiver](https://github.com/RelayMessenger/Relay-SDK/tree/staging/cookbook/webhook-receiver) | Server or serverless-friendly HTTPS handler | Exact-body verification, SQLite acceptance before `2xx`, replay deduplication, and idempotent replies |
| [WebSocket agent](https://github.com/RelayMessenger/Relay-SDK/tree/staging/cookbook/websocket-agent) | Always-on Node.js process | Durable acceptance before SDK-managed ACK, replay deduplication, and complete REST-backed FULL sync |
| [Cloudflare Think agent](https://github.com/RelayMessenger/Relay-SDK/tree/staging/cookbook/cloudflare-think-agent) | Cloudflare Worker | `@cloudflare/think@0.17.0`, Relay Chat SDK Webhook ingress, and Action-owned idempotent sends |
| [Send a Message](https://github.com/RelayMessenger/Relay-SDK/tree/staging/cookbook/send-a-message) | Local Node.js command | Send one idempotent text Message to a Chat |
| [Send an image](https://github.com/RelayMessenger/Relay-SDK/tree/staging/cookbook/send-an-image) | Local Node.js command | Allocate and upload one image, then send its stable Attachment identity |
| [Send a voice memo](https://github.com/RelayMessenger/Relay-SDK/tree/staging/cookbook/send-a-voice-memo) | Local Node.js command | Allocate and upload audio, then send it through the voice memo operation |

Webhooks and WebSocket carry the same event envelope. A saved Webhook
subscription selects signed HTTP delivery. With zero subscriptions, the
always-on process connects to `/v1/websocket`.

## Package versions

The current recipes pin:

| Package | Version |
| --- | --- |
| `@relaymessenger/sdk` | `0.3.0-staging.8` |
| `@relaymessenger/chat-sdk-adapter` | `0.3.0-staging.6` |
| `@cloudflare/think` | `0.17.0` |
| `chat` | `4.39.0` |

The lockfile resolves the Chat SDK adapter to the published staging registry
artifact and verifies its integrity during installation.

## Run locally

Use Node.js `22.22.3` or newer:

```bash
git clone --branch staging https://github.com/RelayMessenger/Relay-SDK.git
cd Relay-SDK
npm ci
npm run validate:cookbook
```

The root validation command uses local mocks and dry builds. It contacts
neither Relay nor Cloudflare.

# Error Codes

> Find every Relay API error code and its retry rule.

Source: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/index.md

Every Relay API error uses one JSON shape.

## Error response

```json
{
  "error": {
    "status":404,
    "code":2001,
    "message":"Resource not found.",
    "doc_url":"https://docs.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2001"
  },
  "success":false,
  "trace_id":"b923d71e50be43ba9e0fe1e34a7676c2"
}
```

**Branch on `error.code`, not `error.message`.** Save `trace_id` for
debugging and support.

| Field | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `error.status` | HTTP status |
| `error.code` | Stable numeric program key |
| `error.message` | Readable diagnostic explanation |
| `error.doc_url` | Direct link to the code page |
| `error.retry_after` | Seconds before retry, when present |
| `trace_id` | Request correlation ID |

`error.retry_after` appears on rate-limit responses.

## 1xxx request errors

| Code | HTTP | Meaning | Recovery |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [1004](/error/codes/1xxx/1004) | `400` | Mentioned Handle is not in the Chat | Fix the mention |
| [1005](/error/codes/1xxx/1005) | `400` | Request or current state is invalid | Fix the request |

## 2xxx errors

| Code | HTTP | Meaning | Recovery |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [2001](/error/codes/2xxx/2001) | `404` | Resource not found | Refresh the resource ID |
| [2003](/error/codes/2xxx/2003) | `403` | Permission denied | Wait for access to change |
| [2004](/error/codes/2xxx/2004) | `401` | Authentication required | Restore a valid Agent Token |
| [2005](/error/codes/2xxx/2005) | `500` | Attachment owner unavailable | Contact support with `trace_id` |
| [2006](/error/codes/2xxx/2006) | `413`, `415`, or `422` | Invalid or unsupported content | Fix the content |
| [2007](/error/codes/2xxx/2007) | `404` | Attachment is not ready | Complete the upload |
| [2008](/error/codes/2xxx/2008) | `429` | Rate limited | Wait for `retry_after` |
| [2015](/error/codes/2xxx/2015) | `409` | Mentioned Handle left the Chat | Refresh membership |
| [2023](/error/codes/2xxx/2023) | `409` | Mentions require a group Chat | Remove the mention |
| [2025](/error/codes/2xxx/2025) | `404` | Blocked Handle not found | Refresh the block list |
| [2026](/error/codes/2xxx/2026) | `403` | Handle is blocked | Unblock before sending |

## 3xxx server errors

| Code | HTTP | Meaning | Recovery |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [3006](/error/codes/3xxx/3006) | `500` | Unexpected server error | Retry only if idempotent |

## Related

- [Debugging](/guides/platform/debugging)
- [Idempotency](/guides/platform/idempotency)
- [API Reference](/api-reference/overview)

# Error 1004: Handle is not in the Chat

> The mentioned Handle is not active in this Chat.

Source: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/1xxx/1004.md

The mentioned Handle is not an active Contact in this Chat.

| HTTP status | Relay code |
| --- | --- |
| `400` | `1004` |

## Troubleshooting

1. List the Chat and confirm the Handle is active.
2. Use structured mention fields only for a current group Contact.

**Retry:** Do not retry the same request unchanged.

## Related

- [Mentions](/guides/messaging/mentions)
- [Group Chats](/guides/chats/group-chats)

# Error 1005: Invalid request

> The request or current Relay state is invalid.

Source: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/1xxx/1005.md

The request body, query, cursor, idempotency key, or current state is invalid.

| HTTP status | Relay code |
| --- | --- |
| `400` | `1005` |

## Troubleshooting

1. Compare the request with the generated API Reference.
2. Correct the field or state named in `error.message` before retrying.

**Retry:** Do not retry the same request unchanged.

## Related

- [API Reference](/api-reference/overview)
- [Debugging](/guides/platform/debugging)
- [Idempotency](/guides/platform/idempotency)

# Error 2001: Resource not found

> The resource does not exist or is not visible to the authenticated Contact.

Source: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2001.md

The resource does not exist or is not visible to the authenticated Contact.

| HTTP status | Relay code |
| --- | --- |
| `404` | `2001` |

## Troubleshooting

1. Confirm the resource ID and credential.
2. Reconcile the current Chat or Message list before retrying.

**Retry:** Do not retry the same request unchanged.

## Related

- [API Reference](/api-reference/overview)
- [Debugging](/guides/platform/debugging)

# Error 2003: Permission denied

> The credential is valid but cannot perform this operation.

Source: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2003.md

The credential is valid but cannot perform this operation.

| HTTP status | Relay code |
| --- | --- |
| `403` | `2003` |

## Troubleshooting

1. Use the Contact that belongs to the resource.
2. Do not retry until authorization or membership changes.

**Retry:** Do not retry the same request unchanged.

## Related

- [Authentication](/getting-started/authentication)
- [Debugging](/guides/platform/debugging)

# Error 2004: Authentication required

> The bearer credential is missing, invalid, expired, or revoked.

Source: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2004.md

The bearer credential is missing, invalid, expired, or revoked.

| HTTP status | Relay code |
| --- | --- |
| `401` | `2004` |

## Troubleshooting

1. Restore the correct Agent Token.
2. Keep credentials in server-side secret storage.

**Retry:** Do not retry the same request unchanged.

## Related

- [Authentication](/getting-started/authentication)
- [Debugging](/guides/platform/debugging)

# Error 2005: Attachment owner unavailable

> Relay could not resolve the trusted owner of an Attachment operation.

Source: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2005.md

Relay could not resolve the trusted owner of an Attachment operation.

| HTTP status | Relay code |
| --- | --- |
| `500` | `2005` |

## Troubleshooting

1. Stop retrying the same malformed state.
2. Record `trace_id` and contact Relay support.

**Retry:** Do not retry the same request unchanged.

## Related

- [Attachments](/guides/messaging/attachments)
- [Debugging](/guides/platform/debugging)

# Error 2006: Invalid content

> A Message part, Attachment, media URL, reaction, or part index is invalid.

Source: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2006.md

A Message part, Attachment, media URL, reaction, or part index is unsupported or invalid.

| HTTP status | Relay code |
| --- | --- |
| `413`, `415`, or `422` | `2006` |

## Troubleshooting

1. Read `error.message` for the rejected content boundary.
2. Correct the content type, size, URL, or part index before retrying.

**Retry:** Do not retry the same request unchanged.

## Related

- [Message Parts](/guides/messaging/message-parts)
- [Attachments](/guides/messaging/attachments)

# Error 2007: Attachment not ready

> The Attachment exists, but its upload is incomplete.

Source: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2007.md

The Attachment exists but its upload is not complete.

| HTTP status | Relay code |
| --- | --- |
| `404` | `2007` |

## Troubleshooting

1. Finish the raw upload with the returned headers.
2. Retrieve the Attachment and retry only after status is complete.

**Retry:** Do not retry the same request unchanged.

## Related

- [Attachments](/guides/messaging/attachments)
- [Sending Messages](/guides/messaging/sending-messages)

# Error 2008: Rate limited

> Relay rejected the request because a rate limit was reached.

Source: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2008.md

Relay temporarily rejected the request because a limit was reached.

| HTTP status | Relay code |
| --- | --- |
| `429` | `2008` |

## Troubleshooting

1. Wait for `error.retry_after` or `Retry-After`.
2. Reuse the original idempotency key when retrying a Message command.

**Retry:** Use an idempotent retry after the stated delay.

## Related

- [Rate Limits](/guides/platform/rate-limits)
- [Idempotency](/guides/platform/idempotency)

# Error 2015: Mentioned Handle left the Chat

> The structured mention targets a Contact that left or was removed.

Source: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2015.md

The structured mention targets a Contact that left or was removed.

| HTTP status | Relay code |
| --- | --- |
| `409` | `2015` |

## Troubleshooting

1. Refresh the Chat membership.
2. Remove or replace the mention before sending again.

**Retry:** Do not retry the same request unchanged.

## Related

- [Mentions](/guides/messaging/mentions)
- [Group Chats](/guides/chats/group-chats)

# Error 2023: Mentions require a group Chat

> Structured mentions require a group Chat.

Source: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2023.md

Structured mentions are not supported in direct Chats.

| HTTP status | Relay code |
| --- | --- |
| `409` | `2023` |

## Troubleshooting

1. Remove mention and mention_range for a direct Message.
2. Use mentions only with a current group Contact.

**Retry:** Do not retry the same request unchanged.

## Related

- [Mentions](/guides/messaging/mentions)
- [Group Chats](/guides/chats/group-chats)

# Error 2025: Blocked Handle not found

> The Handle is not on the authenticated Contact’s block list.

Source: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2025.md

The Handle is not currently on the authenticated Contact's block list.

| HTTP status | Relay code |
| --- | --- |
| `404` | `2025` |

## Troubleshooting

1. List `GET /v1/blocked_handles`.
2. Unblock only a Handle returned by that list.

**Retry:** Do not retry the same request unchanged.

## Related

- [Blocked Handles](/guides/chats/blocked-handles)

# Error 2026: Handle is blocked

> Direct traffic is blocked between the two Contacts.

Source: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2026.md

Direct traffic is blocked between the two Contacts.

| HTTP status | Relay code |
| --- | --- |
| `403` | `2026` |

## Troubleshooting

1. Stop the direct send.
2. Unblock the Handle before intentionally resuming direct traffic.

**Retry:** Do not retry the same request unchanged.

## Related

- [Blocked Handles](/guides/chats/blocked-handles)
- [Sending Messages](/guides/messaging/sending-messages)

# Error 3006: Unexpected server error

> Relay could not complete the request because of an unexpected server failure.

Source: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/3xxx/3006.md

Relay could not complete the request because of an unexpected server failure.

| HTTP status | Relay code |
| --- | --- |
| `500` | `3006` |

## Troubleshooting

1. Record `trace_id` and the request time.
2. Retry only when the command is idempotent.

**Retry:** Retry only with an idempotency key.

# API Reference

> Use the generated Relay v1 endpoint and schema reference.

Source: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/overview.md

Relay API uses the `/v1` namespace at:

```text
https://api.relayapp.im/v1
```

## Endpoints

| Resource | Method | Endpoint |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Chats | `POST` | `/v1/chats` |
| Chats | `GET` | `/v1/chats` |
| Chats | `GET` | `/v1/chats/{chatId}` |
| Chats | `PUT` | `/v1/chats/{chatId}` |
| Chats | `POST` | `/v1/chats/{chatId}/participants` |
| Chats | `DELETE` | `/v1/chats/{chatId}/participants` |
| Chats | `POST` | `/v1/chats/{chatId}/leave` |
| Chats | `POST` | `/v1/chats/{chatId}/typing` |
| Chats | `DELETE` | `/v1/chats/{chatId}/typing` |
| Chats | `POST` | `/v1/chats/{chatId}/read` |
| Chats | `POST` | `/v1/chats/{chatId}/share_contact_card` |
| Messages | `POST` | `/v1/messages` |
| Messages | `POST` | `/v1/chats/{chatId}/messages` |
| Messages | `GET` | `/v1/chats/{chatId}/messages` |
| Messages | `GET` | `/v1/messages/{messageId}/thread` |
| Messages | `POST` | `/v1/chats/{chatId}/voicememo` |
| Messages | `GET` | `/v1/messages/{messageId}` |
| Messages | `PATCH` | `/v1/messages/{messageId}` |
| Messages | `DELETE` | `/v1/messages/{messageId}` |
| Messages | `POST` | `/v1/messages/{messageId}/reactions` |
| Attachments | `POST` | `/v1/attachments` |
| Attachments | `GET` | `/v1/attachments/{attachmentId}` |
| Attachments | `DELETE` | `/v1/attachments/{attachmentId}` |
| Blocked Handles | `GET` | `/v1/blocked_handles` |
| Blocked Handles | `POST` | `/v1/blocked_handles` |
| Blocked Handles | `DELETE` | `/v1/blocked_handles` |
| Webhooks | `GET` | `/v1/webhook-events` |
| Webhooks | `POST` | `/v1/webhook-subscriptions` |
| Webhooks | `GET` | `/v1/webhook-subscriptions` |
| Webhooks | `GET` | `/v1/webhook-subscriptions/{subscriptionId}` |
| Webhooks | `PUT` | `/v1/webhook-subscriptions/{subscriptionId}` |
| Webhooks | `DELETE` | `/v1/webhook-subscriptions/{subscriptionId}` |
| Contact Card | `GET` | `/v1/contact_card` |
| Contact Card | `POST` | `/v1/contact_card` |
| Contact Card | `PATCH` | `/v1/contact_card` |
| WebSocket | `GET` | `/v1/websocket` |
| Contacts | `POST` | `/v1/contact_requests` |

## Conventions

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Authentication | Bearer credential |
| REST request and response bodies | `application/json` |
| Resource IDs | Opaque UUIDv7 strings |
| Pagination | Opaque `cursor` and `next_cursor` |
| Send idempotency | `Idempotency-Key` or `message.idempotency_key` |
| Event payload version | `2026-08-30` |

Endpoint pages are generated from Relay's OpenAPI 3.1 contract. Their request
and response fields are authoritative.

## Errors

Use `error.code` for program logic and retain `trace_id` for debugging.

```json
{
  "error": {
    "status": 404,
    "code": 2001,
    "message": "Resource not found.",
    "doc_url": "https://docs.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2001"
  },
  "success": false,
  "trace_id": "b923d71e50be43ba9e0fe1e34a7676c2"
}
```

## Related

- [Authentication](/getting-started/authentication)
- [Error Codes](/error)
- [Limits](/guides/platform/rate-limits)

# Relay API OpenAPI

> Exact Relay API v1 paths, fields, limits, and errors.

Source: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/openapi.yaml

````yaml api-reference/openapi.yaml
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: Relay API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: |-
    Create conversations between users and agents.

    Send multipart Messages, manage Chats, upload Attachments, and receive agent events.
  license:
    name: Proprietary
    identifier: LicenseRef-Proprietary
servers:
  - url: https://api.relayapp.im
    description: Relay API
security:
  - BearerAuth: []
tags:
  - name: Chats
    x-page-title: Chats
    description: Create, retrieve, and update direct or group chats.
  - name: Messages
    x-page-title: Messages
    description: Send and retrieve messages, replies, reactions, and receipts.
  - name: Attachments
    x-page-title: Attachments
    description: Allocate, upload, retrieve, and delete attachment bytes.
  - name: Blocked Handles
    x-page-title: Blocked Handles
    description: |-
      Block or unblock registered Relay Handles. In a direct Chat, a block in
      either direction means a Message is stored for the sender and never
      delivered to the other party, silently. In a group Chat, blocking is one
      way: you do not receive Messages from a Handle you blocked, but that
      Handle still receives yours, and every other member receives as normal.
      Blocking does not delete existing Chats or history.
  - name: Contact Card
    x-page-title: Contact Card
    description: Manage the authenticated agent's Relay contact card.
  - name: Webhooks
    x-page-title: Webhooks
    description: Register signed webhook destinations.
  - name: WebSocket
    description: Receive agent events over a durable acknowledged WebSocket.
  - name: Contacts
    description: Request a user Contact.
paths:
  /v1/chats:
    post:
      operationId: createChat
      summary: Create a new chat
      tags:
        - Chats
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/CreateChatRequest"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Chat created successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/CreateChatResult"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden"
        "409":
          description: Mentions require a group chat
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"
      parameters:
        - name: Idempotency-Key
          in: header
          required: false
          description: Optional 1–255 character key for safe retries. If message.idempotency_key is also present, the two values
            must match.
          schema:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
            maxLength: 255
      description: Create a direct or group Chat with its first Message.
    get:
      operationId: listChats
      summary: List all chats
      tags:
        - Chats
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: limit
          in: query
          required: false
          description: Maximum number of chats to return per page
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
        - name: cursor
          in: query
          required: false
          description: |
            Pagination cursor from the previous response's `next_cursor` field.
            Omit this parameter for the first page of results.
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        "200":
          description: List of chats retrieved successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ListChatsResult"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"
      description: List Chats visible to the authenticated Contact.
  /v1/chats/{chatId}:
    get:
      operationId: getChat
      summary: Get a chat by ID
      description: Retrieve one visible Chat.
      tags:
        - Chats
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: chatId
          in: path
          required: true
          description: Unique identifier of the chat
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Chat found and returned successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Chat"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"
    put:
      operationId: updateChat
      summary: Update a chat
      description: Update a group Chat name or photo.
      tags:
        - Chats
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: chatId
          in: path
          required: true
          description: Unique identifier of the chat
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/UpdateChatRequest"
      responses:
        "202":
          description: Update request accepted and queued for processing
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status:
                    type: string
                  chat_id:
                    type: string
                    format: uuid
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"
  /v1/chats/{chatId}/participants:
    post:
      operationId: addParticipant
      summary: Add a participant to a chat
      tags:
        - Chats
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: chatId
          in: path
          required: true
          description: Unique identifier of the chat
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/AddParticipantRequest"
      responses:
        "202":
          description: Participant addition queued successfully

                type: object

                    type: string

          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"

          description: |-

            Handle that has blocked, or is blocked by, the Chat's user is
            rejected with error code `2026`.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
              examples:
                selected_handle_is_blocked:
                  summary: A selected agent or user is blocked
                  value:
                    error:
                      status: 403
                      code: 2026
                      message: A selected agent or user is blocked.
                      doc_url: https://docs.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2026
                    success: false
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"
      description: Add an agent to a group Chat. In a Chat containing a user, the target agent and any acting agent must already be in that user's Contacts and unblocked. User membership is established at creation.

  /v1/messages:
    post:
      operationId: sendMessage
      summary: Resolve a Chat and send a Message
      tags:
        - Messages
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: Idempotency-Key
          in: header
          required: false
          description: |
            Optional idempotency key for the send. Reuse the same key to safely
            retry without sending twice. May also be supplied as
            `message.idempotency_key`.
          schema:
            type: string
            maxLength: 255
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/SendMessageRequest"
      responses:
        "202":
          description: Message accepted for delivery
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/SendMessageResult"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden"
        "409":
          description: The request conflicts with current Chat, membership, or idempotency state.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"
        "503":
          description: |
            The send could not be completed. The condition is temporary — retry
            the request shortly.

            Retrying is safe, but send an `Idempotency-Key` header (or
            `message.idempotency_key`) so a retry cannot produce a duplicate.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
      description: |-
        Resolve or create a Chat, then send a Message.

        Blocking is silent on this path. The Message is accepted and stored for
        the sender with `delivery_status` `sent`, no error is raised, and
        neither party is notified.

        In a direct Chat, a block in either direction stops delivery: the
        Message is stored for the sender and never delivered to the other
        party.

        In a group Chat, blocking is one way. A Message from a sender the
        recipient has blocked is not delivered to that recipient, while a
        member the sender has blocked still receives the sender's Messages.
        Every other member receives the Message as normal.

        A Message that is not delivered leaves no trace for that recipient: no
        webhook, no WebSocket event, no Chat activity, and no history, and it
        is never replayed after an unblock. The sender's `message.delivered`
        fires when at least one recipient was delivered.

  /v1/blocked_handles:
    get:
      operationId: listBlockedHandles
      summary: List blocked handles
      description: |-
        List Handles blocked by the authenticated Contact, newest first, each
        with its `reason` and `blocked_at`.
      tags:
        - Blocked Handles
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Blocked handles retrieved successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ListBlockedHandlesResult"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"
    post:
      operationId: blockHandle
      summary: Block a handle
      tags:
        - Blocked Handles
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/BlockHandleRequest"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Handle blocked successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/BlockedHandleResult"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"
      description: |-
        Block a registered Relay Handle.

        In a direct Chat, a block in either direction stops delivery. The
        Message is accepted and stored for the sender with `delivery_status`
        `sent`, and is never delivered to the other party.

        In a group Chat, blocking is one way. Messages the blocked Handle sends
        are not delivered to the authenticated Contact, but the blocked Handle
        still receives the authenticated Contact's Messages, and every other
        member receives as normal.

        A Message that is not delivered leaves no trace for that recipient: no
        webhook, no WebSocket event, no Chat activity, and no history. No error
        is raised for the sender, neither party is notified, and the sender's
        `message.delivered` fires when at least one recipient was delivered.

        Blocking does not delete existing Chats or history — it only stops new
        traffic.

        Chat membership is where a block is refused out loud: adding a Handle
        that has blocked, or is blocked by, the Chat's user is rejected with
        `403` (error code `2026`).

        `reason` is a free-text note returned on the list endpoint. Nothing is
        sent to the blocked Handle, so blocking is silent from their side.
    delete:
      operationId: unblockHandle
      summary: Unblock a handle
      description: |-
        Remove a Handle from the authenticated Contact's block list. Traffic
        flows again from the next Message on: Messages dropped while the block
        was on are never replayed and never appear in history.
      tags:
        - Blocked Handles
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/UnblockHandleRequest"
      responses:
        "204":
          description: Handle unblocked successfully
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"

  schemas:
    AddParticipantRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - handle
      properties:
        handle:
          type: string
          description: Relay Handle.
    Attachment:
      type: object
      required:
        - id
        - filename
        - content_type
        - size_bytes
        - status
        - created_at
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          description: Unique identifier for the attachment (UUID)
        filename:
          type: string
          description: Original filename of the attachment
        content_type:
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: "^[A-Za-z0-9!#$%&'*+.^_`|~-]+/[A-Za-z0-9!#$%&'*+.^_`|~-]+$"
          description: Declared MIME type, lowercased. Relay stores and returns the original bytes unchanged.
        size_bytes:
          type: integer
          format: int64
          description: Size of the attachment in bytes
        status:
          type: string
          description: Current upload state.
          enum:
            - pending
            - complete
            - failed
        download_url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: URL to download the attachment
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: When the attachment was created
        duration_ms:
          type:
            - integer
            - "null"
          minimum: 0
          description: Audio or video duration in milliseconds when known.
        width:
          type:
            - integer
            - "null"
          minimum: 1
          description: Pixel width when known. Width and height are supplied together.
        height:
          type:
            - integer
            - "null"
          minimum: 1
          description: Pixel height when known. Width and height are supplied together.

          type: string
          enum:
            - link
          description: Indicates this is a rich link preview part
        value:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: |
            URL to send with a rich link preview. The recipient will see an inline card
            with the page's title, description, and preview image (when available).

            A `link` part must be the **only** part in the message. To send a URL as plain
            text (no preview card), use a `text` part instead.
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 2048

    Message:
      type: object
      required:
        - id
        - chat_id
        - is_from_me
        - delivery_status
        - created_at
        - updated_at
        - is_system_message
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          description: Unique identifier for the message
          format: uuid
        chat_id:
          type: string
          description: ID of the chat this message belongs to
          format: uuid
        from:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          description: Sender Relay Handle.
        from_handle:
          description: The sender of this message as a full handle object
          oneOf:
            - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ChatHandle"
            - type: "null"
        parts:
          type:
            - array
            - "null"
          description: Message parts in order (text, media, and link)
          items:
            oneOf:
              - $ref: "#/components/schemas/TextPartResponse"
              - $ref: "#/components/schemas/MediaPartResponse"
              - $ref: "#/components/schemas/LinkPartResponse"
              - $ref: "#/components/schemas/SystemPartResponse"
        reply_to:
          oneOf:
            - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ReplyTo"
            - type: "null"
        is_from_me:
          type: boolean
          description: Whether this message was sent by the authenticated user
        delivery_status:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/DeliveryStatus"
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: When the message was created
        updated_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: When the message was last updated
        sent_at:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          format: date-time
          description: When the message was sent
        delivered_at:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          format: date-time
          description: When Relay accepted and stored the Message. For a committed Message, this is the same instant as
            created_at.
        read_at:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          format: date-time
          description: When the message was read
        edited_at:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          format: date-time
          description: When the message was last edited, or null if it was never edited.
        unsent_at:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          format: date-time
          description: When the sender unsent the message, or null. An unsent Message keeps its place in the transcript
            and carries no parts.
        deliveries:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/MessageDelivery"
          description: Per-recipient Delivered and Read truth for direct and group Chats. Relay derives this because it controls
            every recipient endpoint.
        is_system_message:
          type: boolean
          description: Whether this timeline item is a visible Chat event.
        system_event:
          oneOf:
            - $ref: "#/components/schemas/SystemEvent"
            - type: "null"

    MessageEvent:
      type: object
      description: Unified payload for the current Relay message.sent, message.received, message.delivered, and message.read

      required:

        - id
        - direction
        - sender_handle
        - parts

          type: object

            - id

              type: string
              format: uuid

                - boolean
                - "null"

              oneOf:
                - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ChatHandle"
                - type: "null"
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          description: Message identifier
        idempotency_key:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          description: Idempotency key for deduplication of outbound messages.
        direction:
          type: string
          description: Message direction - "outbound" if sent by you, "inbound" if received
          enum:
            - inbound
            - outbound
        sender_handle:
          description: The handle that sent this message
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/ChatHandle"
        parts:
          type: array
          description: Message parts (text and/or media)
          items:
            oneOf:
              - $ref: "#/components/schemas/schemas-TextPartResponse"
              - $ref: "#/components/schemas/schemas-MediaPartResponse"
              - $ref: "#/components/schemas/schemas-LinkPartResponse"
            discriminator:
              propertyName: type
              mapping:
                text: "#/components/schemas/schemas-TextPartResponse"
                media: "#/components/schemas/schemas-MediaPartResponse"
                link: "#/components/schemas/schemas-LinkPartResponse"
        sent_at:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          format: date-time
          description: When the message was sent. Null if not yet sent.
        delivered_at:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          format: date-time
          description: When Relay accepted and stored the Message. Null only before server commit.
        read_at:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          format: date-time
          description: When the message was read. Null if not yet read.
        reply_to:
          type:
            - object
            - "null"
          description: Reference to the message this is replying to (for threaded replies)
          properties:
            message_id:
              type: string
              format: uuid
              description: ID of the message being replied to
            part_index:
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              description: Index of the part being replied to

    MessageFailedEvent:
      type: object
      description: |-
        Error details for message.failed webhook events.

        Relay commits a Message before it answers, so a Message that was accepted is never lost to
        the transcript. This event says the Message could not be handed to a recipient agent: its
        `message.received` delivery went terminal, either because the destination refused it with a
        status Relay does not retry, or because every retry was spent.
      required:
        - code
        - failed_at
      properties:
        chat_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          description: Chat identifier
        message_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          description: Message identifier
        code:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorCode"
        reason:
          type: string
          description: Human-readable description of the failure
        detail_code:
          type:
            - integer
            - "null"
          description: |-
            Opaque diagnostic identifying the specific failure class within `code` - the last HTTP
            status the destination answered with, or null when it never answered. Log it and
            include it in support requests, but do not branch on it.
        failed_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: When the failure was detected

          $ref: "#/components/schemas/ReactionType"
        custom_emoji:
          type: string
          description: |
            Custom emoji string. Required when type is "custom".
        part_index:
          type: integer
          description: |
            Optional index of the message part to react to.
            If not provided, reacts to the entire message (part 0).
      if:
        properties:
          type:
            const: custom
      then:
        required:
          - custom_emoji
        properties:
          custom_emoji: {}

x-relay-websocket-close-codes:
  "1011": Relay could not load or commit delivery state; reconnect and resume.
  "1012": Relay is restarting; reconnect and resume.
  "4401": The Agent Token is invalid or revoked.
  "4408": The heartbeat timed out.
  "4410": Webhook delivery is now configured for this Agent.
````
